settings.label: Server Address
settings.help: The address of your Subsonic, Navidrome or other Subsonic-compatible server, such as https://music.example.com or http://192.168.1.5:4533

settings.label: Username
settings.help: The account the plugin signs in with.

settings.label: Password
settings.help: Kept on this computer by the app, in the plugin's settings file. Each request is signed with a token made from it, never sent as it is.
